source: Existing P16 7.2.8 kernel source with repository SPI HID patch series 2111-2120 and P16 fixes
adaptation: Evaluate _RST on the ACPI handle directly; the acpi_device dev has no companion fwnode for device_reset(). Respect HID_INPUT_REPORT versus HID_FEATURE_REPORT, handle GET_INPUT_REPORT_RESPONSE, and keep reply copying under the output mutex. P16-specific asynchronous .request handling: its VEML3328 task ignores GET_INPUT_REPORT, so IIO pending reads are fulfilled by DATA reports; raw synchronous input ioctls return EOPNOTSUPP.
